== Notes ==
* When the Shambling Horror dies, the [[spawn]]ed Jagged Horror will trigger [[Explosive Growth]], [[Boon of Creation]], and [[Spirit's Gift]].
* Shambling Horrors are good targets for [[Taste of Death]] and [[Feast for the Dead]], since it leaves a Jagged Horror when it dies.
* When combined with [[Jagged Bones]], two Jagged Horrors are produced.
* The level of the Jagged Horror is determined by the Death Magic rank of the caster when the Shambling Horror was created.
* [[Masterless minion|Masterless]] Shambling Horrors do not spawn a Jagged Horror when they die.
* This skill has a much longer recharge when compared to most animation skills, and thus cannot be relied upon alone to create a full army of minions.
* The bleeding lasts for 25 seconds.
{{anomaly|The descriptions do not mention the [[duration]] of the bleeding inflicted by the Jagged Horror.}}
